W2-18's KPI at WBS:440 would fix W2-M123, but W2-18 covers product repositories only and its allowed paths exclude this repository's hook source. The guard writes no reason to standard error on its own failures, and W2-10's KPIs don't cover that case. DEC-732 item 3 gives a wrong reason: hooks run the tree as it is on disk at each call, not the code the session started under.
